title: Exotic Velvety Thai Peas Khao Soi
description: A jammy and velvety Thai dish featuring peas and coconut cream, this recipe is perfect for meal prep and can be served raw or cooked. It is a unique twist on traditional Khao Soi.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut cream and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the peas, soy sauce, and fish sauce (if using) to the pan.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the peas are tender.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
Combine the noodles and pea mixture in a large bowl.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs or scallions if desired.
